title.zh: 将宿务省 Minglanilla 市镇一所国立中学的附属校分离，设立独立的 Lipata Central I 国立中学并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Guindaruhan National High School Extension in the Municipality of Minglanilla, Province of Cebu, From the Guindaruhan National High School and Converting It Into An Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Lipata Central I National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Guindaruhan National High School Extension in the Municipality of Minglanilla, Province of Cebu, From the Guindaruhan National High School and Converting It Into An Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Lipata Central I National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu của Trường Trung học Guindaruhan Quốc gia tại Đô thị Minglanilla, Tỉnh Cebu khỏi Trường Trung học Guindaruhan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Lipata Central I Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขตของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guindaruhan แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Minglanilla จังหวัด Cebu ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Guindaruhan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lipata Central I แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Guindaruhan Nasional di Kotamadya Minglanilla, Provinsi Cebu dari Sekolah Menengah Guindaruhan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lipata Central I Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus, Sekolah Menengah Guindaruhan Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Minglanilla, Wilayah Cebu daripada Sekolah Menengah Guindaruhan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Lipata Central I Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Guindaruhan National High School Extension in Barangay Lipata, Municipality of Minglanilla, Province of Cebu, is hereby separated from the Guindaruhan National High School in the Municipality of Minglanilla and converted into an independent national high school, to be known as the Lipata Central I National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Guindaruhan National High School Extension are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Lipata Central I National High School.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Guindaruhan National High School-Barangay Lipata Extension. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Lipata Central I National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
